description: This Java class defines a custom SLF4J Logger adapter for integrating Liquibase logging with SLF4J logging framework. It extends an abstract logger and routes log messages at various levels to the appropriate SLF4J logger methods.

classes.name: Slf4JLogger
classes.description: A logging class that adapts Liquibase logging calls to SLF4J framework loggers, mapping different java.util.logging Levels to SLF4J levels.

methods.name: Slf4JLogger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes SLF4J logger for a given class and applies a message filter.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Routes log messages from Liquibase to SLF4J, mapping java.util.logging.Level to SLF4J levels, and handles base logging with message and exception.
